scope: Local QA checker only; document specification, not implementation permission

technical_defaults.platform: Linux with required process-observation and resource controls available; WSL is guest scope only; otherwise UNSUPPORTED_ENVIRONMENT
technical_defaults.calibration: PROVISIONAL_NOT_MEASURED; inability to run within limits yields bounded refusal/failure, never automatic limit expansion
technical_defaults.creation_limit: Process creation and uninterruptible kernel operations have no guaranteed wall-time bound; report observed overrun without real-time guarantee.
technical_defaults.diagnostic_os_default: DISABLED; explicit authorized configured source required

admission_and_identity.journal: Persist run_id, boot identity, owner identity, checker/version digest, policy digest and RESERVED before attempting launch; then attach PID plus start identity. No report content in journal.
admission_and_identity.coordination: Single cooperating supervisor owner per local state directory; account-wide or unrelated-process exclusivity not claimed.
admission_and_identity.recovery: Unresolved RESERVED/ACTIVE/STOPPING or unavailable/corrupt journal -> INFRA_LOCK. PID alone or human acknowledgement cannot unlock.
admission_and_identity.release: Require identity-bound evidence no prior owned process remains and complete admission reconciliation. If unavailable remain locked; no automatic host restart.
admission_and_identity.durability: No launch until required journal persistence confirmed; failure blocks admission. Crash-window tests are mandatory acceptance tests, not completed evidence.
admission_and_identity.journal_budget: Separate state journal maximum64KiB; not a receipt and never cleared by receipt cleanup. Corrupt/oversized/unavailable state blocks new launches.

protocol.binding: Checker0.1.3 exact approved file/dependency digests recorded in manifest; changed bytes require new adapter review.
protocol.json: Exactly one bounded UTF-8 JSON object; reject duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, trailing non-whitespace, incomplete or unsupported fields.
protocol.output_contract: checker-output.schema.json plus protocol-contract.json; observed returncode envelope, not child-controlled code.
protocol.observation: Complete typed failure_observation; no inferred authenticity. Do not recover malformed output by substring searching.

notification_policy.channel: Local response/receipt only; no email, external messages or platform integrations.
notification_policy.blocking: All incomplete or failed evaluations prohibit acceptance of that evaluation. INFRA_LOCK additionally prohibits new launches.
notification_policy.urgency: Do not assign domain-critical severity without target-system criteria; label unverified/pending distinctly. Request human decision on exceptions.
notification_policy.retry: No automatic retry; require corrected/reconciled conditions and a fresh request.

retention_proposal.human_decisions: Retain raw local QA stdout/stderr; 32 MiB capacity; manual deletion. No time-based expiration.
retention_proposal.stdout_stderr: Persist bounded bytes separately from structured receipt; stdout<=262144 bytes, stderr<=65536 bytes. Untrusted data, never commands. No raw OS logs.
retention_proposal.receipt: Typed outcome/exit/signal/limits/digests/run identity and fixed codes only; <=8192 bytes; raw output stored separately and bound to run identity and byte digest. Hashes do not authenticate or anonymize.
retention_proposal.file_permissions: Owner-only files 0600, directories 0700; no automatic external transfer.
retention_proposal.capacity: Single shared 32 MiB logical byte budget for receipts, raw output, staging and orphan files; max100 run slots including reservations. This is not a physical disk quota; filesystem overhead/ENOSPC remain infrastructure failures.
retention_proposal.reservation: Before launch reconcile storage; require count+1<=100 and accounted_bytes+reserved_bytes+335872<=33554432. Reserve one slot and 335872 bytes atomically among cooperating invokers. Unknown accounting or insufficient capacity blocks new work.
retention_proposal.deletion: MANUAL_ONLY; no automatic expiry, purge, overwrite or oldest-record eviction. Manual export does not delete originals. No deletion command executed by this design.
retention_proposal.manual_cleanup: Only completed/unreserved run artifacts may be removed through the authorized local operation. Reconcile resulting accounting before admission; deleting output/receipts never clears INFRA_LOCK or changes the separate journal.
retention_proposal.failure: Write failure leaves persistence UNCONFIRMED; count existing partial/staging bytes, preserve lock and original evaluation status, never claim durable output. No automatic checker retry.
retention_proposal.journal: Separate journal <=65536 bytes excluded from 32 MiB output budget and never deleted by output cleanup.
retention_proposal.technical_default: 100 runs and per-stream/receipt caps are conservative engineering bounds, not throughput or physical-capacity measurements.
retention_proposal.reservation_lifecycle: Reservation is outstanding not-yet-materialized bytes. Under the cooperating admission lock, each committed byte moves from reservation to accounted storage without double counting. Uncertain partial writes are conservatively counted; unknown balance blocks admission. Release unused reservation only after exact run completion and storage reconciliation, never merely on a signal, receipt deletion or human acknowledgement.

final_gates: Native Gentle RDD if available and consented

temporal_contract.clock: Monotonic; recorded duration observations not real-time guarantees.
temporal_contract.t0: Immediately before invoking process creation, after admission and durable RESERVED.
temporal_contract.work_deadline: t0+30s includes launch attempt, execution and capture. If process creation returns after this deadline, classify WALL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED and enter cleanup immediately; do not accept a late favorable result.
temporal_contract.first_stop: Upon first deadline, output cap or cancel event, record reason and request graceful termination of exact owned child; t_stop is monotonic time the stop sequence begins.
temporal_contract.grace_deadline: t_stop+2s. If termination confirmed before then, classify original interruption and persist. Otherwise request forced termination of exact owned child, record attempt; t_force is time this request is issued.
temporal_contract.confirmation_deadline: t_force+2s. Confirmed termination -> CLASSIFYING with original interruption reason; otherwise INFRA_LOCK. Sending a request is not confirmation.
temporal_contract.unknown_child: If creation outcome/identity cannot be established, INFRA_LOCK without targeting arbitrary PID.
temporal_contract.sum: Nominal budgets30+2+2 do not imply total observed<=34s; scheduling, process creation and kernel waits can delay observation. On regaining control apply overdue transitions; never relabel overrun as success.
temporal_contract.early_trigger: Output limit or cancellation may start cleanup before t0+30. No timeout restart when chunks arrive.
